task.title: Startup Procedure
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to safely start the GrainFlow X50.

section.title: Pre-Start Checklist
section.p: Complete the following checks before starting the machine:

row.entry: Inspect all guards, covers, and safety devices for damage or missing parts
Verify main power supply is connected and within voltage specification (400V ± 10%)
Ensure all interior chambers are free from debris from the previous shift
Check bearing lubrication status. Top up if necessary
Verify emergency stop button is released (twist to reset)

step.cmd: Locate the main power switch on the control panel.

info.p: Refer to the control panel diagram in the appendix.

step.cmd: Turn the switch to the ON position.

info.p: The HMI (Human Machine Interface) will display the startup screen.

step.cmd: Wait 60 seconds for the system self-diagnostic to complete.

info.p: The system checks sensor responses, motor RPM, and fault codes.

step.cmd: Enter the desired throughput rate on the HMI touchscreen.

info.p: Default rate is 50 tonnes per hour. Range is 20-80 TPH.

step.cmd: Press the Start button on the HMI screen to begin operation.

info.p: The system starts main motor, conveyor belt, and cleaning process.
